hypothesis: A three-parameter observable-reference-driven contractive innovation gain can adapt scalar transient filtering without state labels and improve prediction beyond constant-gain and magnitude-only adaptation.

model.reference_bank: exact RW plus rho=[0,.25,.5,.75,.9,.97] x permanent_variance_fraction=[.02,.1,.25,.5,.8]; unchanged Stage D scalar Kalman recursion
model.reference_selection: past 240 one-step innovation profile likelihood; refit every 20 observation steps
model.features: c_t=(1,tanh(e0_t*e0_(t-1)/(3*s0^2)),tanh(e0_t^2/(3*s0^2))); e0 is the separate selected reference filter's innovation; s0 is initial-training RMS price increment
model.gain: Kmax=(.995-rho)/(1-rho); K_t=Kmax*sigmoid(logit(K0_t/Kmax)+beta dot c_t); exact RW reference forces K_t=0
model.learning: mean normalized squared multihorizon error over last 240 complete mature origins plus lambda*sum(beta^2); labels must satisfy origin+20<=fit_time; rerun current reference on the fitting prefix without rewriting previously issued forecasts
model.solver: L-BFGS-B, analytic forward sensitivities, at most 80 iterations and 120 objective calls per start, two fixed starts: zero and -0.5 in active coordinates; best finite training objective including beta=0
model.fallback: on nonfinite or infeasible fit return beta=0; retain optimizer status and fallback counts
model.contraction_claim: For a fixed parameter/reference schedule and identical observable reference features, transient state initialization differences contract by at most .995 per update. This is not economic-state identification, optimizer global optimality, or future prediction superiority.

same_core_comparisons.GAIN_CONSTANT: beta_0 only; same three lambda values, fit times, loss and starts
same_core_comparisons.LOSS_ONESTEP: fixed-configuration diagnostic only if candidate passes minimum controls; same mature-origin support, only h=1 in training loss
same_core_comparisons.NO_REFERENCE_CONTEXT: fixed-configuration diagnostic only if candidate passes; use raw increments in gate context instead of reference innovations

synthetic.observation_contract: estimators see prices only; constant-process oracle knows parameters but filters prices; switch oracle also knows current generating covariance regime and is explicitly privileged, not a deployable baseline
synthetic.baselines: RW, known-parameter price-filtering oracle, 8 Ridge configurations (L=5/20, lambda=.001/.01/.1/1), CORE_ML and matched constant/magnitude gains
synthetic.minimum_gate: CORE_ML null mean relative MSE<=1.03, signal<=.96; candidate null<=1.03, signal<=.96, weak<=1.05; finite forecasts; actual fallbacks<=1% of fits
synthetic.mechanism_gate: candidate switch mean relative MSE at least 1% lower than both matched constant and matched magnitude-only gains, with >=6/10 paired seed wins against each; otherwise stop before any market fitting
synthetic.scope: minimum finite controls, not a broad simulation theorem; selected hyperparameters per trajectory use tuning only; seed-averaged loss is not forecast ensembling

conditional_market_plan.execution_gate: synthetic minimum and mechanism gates both pass
conditional_market_plan.source: existing data/parsed/figshare_28682348/guangzhou_reported.csv; verify all three CSV hashes; do not redownload prices
conditional_market_plan.tuning: 2020-2021, each year only origins with all targets in same year
conditional_market_plan.validation_2022: not automatic; do not score in this run
conditional_market_plan.strong_baselines: RW; drift windows120/240/480; Ridge L5/20 x lambda .001/.01/.1/1; HistGradientBoosting leaves7/15 x learning_rate .05/.1 x window240/480, 80 rounds and no random early stopping; Stage D CORE_ML windows120/240/480; same-core constant/magnitude/context gains
conditional_market_plan.Cstar: best tuning noncandidate from the complete predeclared pool, including simple constant and magnitude gain learners
conditional_market_plan.gate: candidate >=2% relative reduction in primary score vs RW and Cstar, >=1% vs strongest same-core comparator, no year worse than RW by >5%; otherwise stop without opening later dates
conditional_market_plan.primary_score: equal-year equal-horizon mean MSE ratios to RW; also save RMSE/MAE by horizon/year
conditional_market_plan.uncertainty: paired moving blocks within each year, lengths20/40/60, 2000 draws; all models/horizons jointly sampled; tuning-selected intervals explicitly non-confirmatory

equivalence_tests: zero nonconstant coefficients yields linear time-varying gain, and steady reference gain yields ordinary linear ARMA-shaped filter
candidate generally violates input superposition; this rules out fixed linear filters, not general gated recurrent models
state-feedback Jacobian bound holds only because reference context is separate
compare against direct constant-gain learning and magnitude-only robust gain before attributing improvement to serial context
learned Kalman gains and multistep prediction-error fitting are existing concepts; no first-proposal or completed novelty claim
information_restrictions: do not call source observation dates verified session calendars
do not reopen old blocked PDFs or claim metadata as full text
delivery: new branch only, no main merge; save code, complete configuration results, forecast arrays, optimizer and test logs, literature levels and stop decision, including negative outcomes
